context.transcript:
Have you ever had your car fixed at Tom's Repair Shop?
A. I fill the tank every two weeks.
B. No, but I've heard they do good work.
C. It's in my parking space.
context.transcript_translation:
你以前有没有在 Tom's Repair Shop 修过车？
A. 我每两周加一次油。
B. 没有，但我听说他们做得很好。
C. 它在我停车位里。

items.question: Have you ever had your car fixed at Tom's Repair Shop?

No, but I've heard they do good work.
